subject: Clarify: non‑training assurance + retention windows for ClearWave deployment
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@clearwavehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearWave Legal <legal@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Questions on 'we do not train on customer data' and retention windows

Vanessa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal and our privacy team are assembling final sign‑offs for the pilot and have two tight asks before we progress: a) an explicit, signed attestation that Redwood will not use ClearWave customer content to train models or for model improvements; and b) a precise breakdown of retention for request logs, debugging snapshots, backups, and any telemetry that could contain PII. Regulator expects evidence we will be able to demonstrate deletion within 30 days for customer content and show audit trails for retention exceptions.

I attached our standard security questionnaire and highlighted the relevant sections. Can you confirm what you can provide? We may need an on‑record statement for procurement.

—Elena
Senior Privacy Counsel, ClearWave Health
[attachment: ClearWave-Security-Questionnaire.pdf]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, ClearWave Legal <legal@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on 'we do not train on customer data' and retention windows

Elena —

Appreciate the clear asks. Short answers up front: 1) Redwood will provide a signed non‑training attestation for hosted and Dedicated customers; 2) retention is configurable by deployment mode — default hosted telemetry/logs are retained 90 days, request payloads for customers who opt into the Non‑Learning profile are deleted on a 30‑day cadence, and Dedicated/Private deployments can be set to shorter windows (we've implemented 30‑day TTLs on several pilots).

I attached our draft attestation (non_training_attestation_v1) and an excerpt from our retention runbook that maps snapshots, backups, and KV cache handling to retention buckets. High‑level notes:
- Production backups: retained per your contract (default 90 days); backups marked as customer‑sensitive can be tombstoned and excluded from restores.
- Debug snapshots (engine traces): ephemeral by default and excluded from storage after 7 days unless a customer escalates and requests preservation.
- KV cache: ephemeral per session; not logged to long‑term storage when Non‑Learning is enabled.

We can produce an auditable deletion log for the actions we take (delete request ID, timestamp, operator, reason). For regulatory evidence, we typically provide: signed attestation, deletion-runbook excerpt, and a sample deletion audit export. If ClearWave needs an on‑site control plane proof (Private), we can run a canary and provide the deletion trace.

Propose a 30‑minute call tomorrow to align on the exact artifacts ClearWave needs for procurement. When's good?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of North America Sales, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-nontraining-attestation-v1.pdf; attachment: retention-runbook-excerpt-20261121.pdf]

From: Elena Park <elena@clearwavehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearWave Legal <legal@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T13:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on 'we do not train on customer data' and retention windows

Vanessa —

Thanks — that helps. A couple of follow‑ups from Legal and Privacy:
1) Backups: when you say 'tombstone and exclude from restores', can you describe the tombstone lifecycle (is it immediate, or does it mark for deletion and run on a schedule)? We need a clear deletion timestamp to present to auditors.
2) Who has access to debug snapshots and under what authorization model? We need the identity of roles and an approval workflow.
3) For hosted customers, is there any asynchronous pipeline that samples or stores customer content outside the request path (e.g., analytics/quality pipelines)? If so, how is that data anonymized/retained?

If you can answer these in writing and provide a sample deletion audit (redacted IDs are fine) that shows a delete complete event for a previous customer request, that will speed procurement. If possible, we'd prefer DocuSign‑ready wording for the attestation.

—Elena

[P.S. If you need a template for DocuSign language, Legal can share one quickly.]

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@clearwavehealth.com>, ClearWave Legal <legal@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on 'we do not train on customer data' and retention windows — proposed artifacts and timeline

Looping in technical and compliance for precise artifacts. Elena and legal team — quick summary of what we can deliver this week:

1) DocuSign‑ready non‑training attestation (legal language) — editable, signed by Redwood counsel.
2) Deletion runbook excerpt that includes the tombstone lifecycle: tombstone marker (T0), scheduled purge job (T0 + 72 hours for ephemeral debug snapshots; T0 + 30 days for customer‑flagged content unless contract overrides). We will include the cron windows and operator roles.
3) Sample deletion audit export (redacted) showing request_id, deletion_tombstone_ts, purge_ts, operator_id.
4) An access matrix for debug snapshots and support access (roles: SRE‑support, Infra Eng, Security Incident Response) with required approval workflow and ticketing references.

Action items I'm proposing internally: Neha to produce the sample audit export; Vanessa to coordinate the attestation and DocuSign flow; I'll extract the runbook section and the access matrix. Timeline: we can assemble all artifacts within two business days and route the attestation for signature the following day.

If ClearWave wants a canary deletion execution (we trigger a delete and show the purge event), we can also schedule that during the pilot cutover window.

—Marcus Lin
Director, Product Security
[internal note: produce redacted audit CSV and sanitize IDs]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, ClearWave Legal <legal@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on 'we do not train on customer data' and retention windows — plan and next steps

Elena —

Thanks for the questions and patience. Per Marcus' note, attached are the documents we promised: a DocuSign‑ready non‑training attestation, a retention/runbook excerpt, and a redacted sample deletion audit. Highlights and next steps:

- Attestation: DocuSign link provided below; language confirms Redwood will not use ClearWave content to train models or improve model weights for hosted and Dedicated under the agreed Non‑Learning profile.
- Tombstone lifecycle: when a delete request is executed we mark data as tombstoned (T0) and purge per class: ephemeral debug = purge job within 72 hours; customer request content (Non‑Learning) = purge job within 30 days; backups require explicit contract flag to shorten from default 90 days. All purges generate an audit event with deletion_tombstone_ts and purge_ts.
- Access controls: debug snapshots require a support ticket, approval from SRE manager, and SSO link with just‑in‑time elevation logged via our IAM. Access matrix included in runbook excerpt.

Deliverables attached and linked: redwood-nontraining-attestation-v1.pdf (DocuSign ready), retention-runbook-excerpt-20261123.pdf, and one sample deletion audit export (CSV excerpt embedded in PDF).

If you agree, I'll route the attestation via DocuSign today and we can schedule a short canary test during the pilot kickoff next week (we'll perform a delete and share the purge audit live). Suggested times: 2026‑11‑30 10:00–11:00 PT or 2026‑11‑30 15:00–15:30 PT.

Please confirm preferred slot and whether Legal wants any language edits before we sign.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of North America Sales, Redwood Inference
[attachments: redwood-nontraining-attestation-v1.pdf; retention-runbook-excerpt-20261123.pdf; retention-sample-deletion-audit.pdf]
